name: The Last Train
source:
The world has gone silent. But something is still transmitting.

Years after an unknown catastrophe, a lone survivor lives aboard an old train hidden behind an electrified perimeter.

The train has become his shelter, his home, and perhaps the last safe place left. But supplies are running low, the surrounding fog is growing more dangerous, and a mysterious radio transmission suggests that the outside world may not be as empty as it seems.

[From [url=https://rmwizard.itch.io/thelasttrain-10-demo]itch.io[/url]]
